Overview

Barinas is a city in E with a population of 350,000. A plains city in western Venezuela, the heart of the country’s cattle ranching and agricultural region. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
